question: Should ClawHub accept claimState, officialState, and restrictionState as the admin official-publisher API vocabulary after the derivation bug and runtime proof gap are fixed, or keep this slice spec-only for now?
rationale: The PR introduces trust-state vocabulary and identity derivation semantics that automation cannot choose for maintainers before downstream clients depend on the response shape.

options.title: Fix and prove before accepting
options.body: Require observed-active-user derivation and redacted official-publisher API output before deciding whether to land the new admin response field.

options.title: Split spec-only first
options.body: Keep only the internal state-boundary spec now and defer the runtime API contract to a maintainer-sponsored PR.

options.title: Reject the API vocabulary for now
options.body: Leave current official-publisher responses unchanged until a broader publisher claim and verification policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Fix and prove before accepting
recommendation.body: Require observed-active-user derivation and redacted official-publisher API output before deciding whether to land the new admin response field.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-main owner for the official-publisher admin API and client schema surface changed by this PR.
